drums.tags: Dark ambient soundscape. A low-frequency sub-bass drone oscillates with a slow, rhythmic pulse. High-frequency metallic textures and granular synthesis artifacts create a shimmering, dissonant layer above the low end. A resonant, filtered sweep moves across the stereo field with a long decay. Periodic mechanical clicks and industrial whirs occur at irregular intervals. The piece lacks a traditional melodic structure or rhythmic grid. Key: C minor. Tempo: 60 BPM.

[Section B]
[dissonant high-frequency shimmer increases in intensity]
[sub-bass pulse slows]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. Distorted, overdriven kick drum at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic percussion loop provides high-frequency syncopation. A gritty, monophonic synth bassline plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with a low-pass filter sweep. Industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and white noise bursts, are processed with short room reverb. A dark, atmospheric pad enters in the mid-section with a slow attack. The track features a minimalist, driving structure focused on rhythmic texture and timbral evolution rather than melodic progression.

[Section B]
[low-pass filter opens on bassline]
[atmospheric synth pad swells]

[Outro]
[synth pad fades out]
[kick drum and percussion loop continue to end]
